name: Huan Zhang

fitReason: Combines formal neural-network verification with recent robot world-model and VLM-guided manipulation collaborations; a strong fit for a CS project on reliable physical AI.

physicalEvidence.summary: The March 2026 Interactive World Simulator paper identifies Zhang as a UIUC coauthor and uses an actual ALOHA bimanual robot. Six physical task datasets train the model; policy evaluation tests DP, ACT, pi0 and pi0.5 on four tasks using 20 matched initial configurations. The video world model itself is simulated, while the resulting learned policies are also evaluated on hardware.
